description.vi: Cách chụp (ảnh đầy đủ)
description.en: How the full image is shot

text: Shoot it as a professional architectural interior photograph: full-frame camera, 24–35 mm rectilinear lens at eye level about 1.5 m, f/8 with everything in focus, vertical lines kept perfectly vertical, no fisheye.

description.vi: Ảnh chụp từ trên xuống (góc toàn cảnh, mặt bằng)
description.en: Picture taken from above (overview, plan)

text: The picture looks straight down on the room from above, with the ceiling taken away, like a photorealistic 3D floor plan or a dollhouse cutaway: we see the floor, the cut tops of the walls, the tops of the cabinets and countertops, the stairs and the furniture from above. Keep that bird's-eye camera: do not turn it into an eye-level photograph, do not show cabinet fronts that the image does not show, keep every outline where it is, everything in focus.

description.vi: Mặt bằng chiếu song song (ortho)
description.en: Orthographic plan

text: The view is orthographic, like an architectural plan drawing: no perspective at all, every wall, cabinet and stair drawn to scale with only its top visible; do not add perspective, depth tilt or the sides of objects.

description.vi: Hậu kỳ và độ thật (ảnh đầy đủ)
description.en: Finish and realism of the full image

text: Natural color, realistic dynamic range (no HDR look), very fine natural sensor grain, accurate white balance; the room looks clean and newly installed, with no people, text or clutter. It must be indistinguishable from a real photograph, not a 3D render.

description.vi: Lời dặn dự phòng cho model tự làm các lệnh trong hộp thư (chỉ dùng khi thiếu skill data/skills/kitchen-inbox)
description.en: Fallback instructions for the model that carries out the command inbox (used only when the skill data/skills/kitchen-inbox is missing)

text: You carry out ONE command a kitchen designer typed in the right-click menu of a kitchen design app. You change the design only through the tools. Steps: read the command and what was clicked; if you need it, read the design with get_design; turn the sentence into a previewed operation with the matching tool (opening_command for room doors, windows and passages, their size, their sill above the floor, and for saving the clicked door or cabinet system to the catalog; interpret_edit with the clicked cabinet or group as scope for anything about cabinets, worktop, colours, handles, moldings; propose_template for a run of cabinets along a floorplan object; propose_change when you can write the operation yourself). Check the preview: it must change only what the sentence asks. Then save it with apply_change(expect = the preview's opHash). Finish with answer: status done with one short line saying what changed, in the command's language; status question when the sentence is unclear, a tool asks back, or the preview shows a problem the user must decide (a space too shallow, an appliance that does not fit, an error the change brings in): save nothing, put the question with 2 to 4 short choices of how to go on (the app shows them as a panel the user picks from), never guess sizes or which cabinet; status failed when it cannot be done (say why). Never remove, replace or resize something the sentence does not name. One command, then answer.

description.en: Directions of a geometry edit (remove / add / replace)

table.remove-item: Where an object is removed, image 3 shows what is behind it (wall, floor, the side of the neighbouring cabinet, the countertop end, the plinth): paint those surfaces with the same materials, colors and lighting as the matching surfaces elsewhere in image 1, so nothing of the removed object remains.
table.add-item: Paint the new object(s) shown in image 3 with realistic materials that match the existing cabinets of image 1 (same finish, color and hardware style unless stated).
table.replace-item: Keep the materials, colors and finish that image 1 has in this region; change only the shape / style so it matches image 3.

text: Turn the kitchen-cabinet edit command into ONE JSON operation. Use only: {"op":"add","module":{"type","width"},"afterModule":id} | {"op":"remove","id"} | {"op":"update","id","changes":{...}} | {"op":"common","changes":{...}} | {"op":"multi","ops":[...]}. Units are mm. When unclear, reply {"op":"none"}.
